Maria: Heads up — sample-app pager is causing duplicate upstream requests under burst. Might be a prefetch + auth-retry interaction. Logs attached below.
Jordan: ah, can you paste the minimal repro?
Maria: gist of logs: `GET /v1/items?page=2` triggered twice within 30ms, then a 429. stack shows SDK prefetcher + token refresh path.
Sam: is this the JS SDK or Go? we've had different prefetch strategies.
Maria: JS (web sample-app). Repro steps: open feed, scroll quickly, network offline/online toggle. Also seen when token refresh is slow.
Jordan: could be the prefetcher not using a per-page lock. If two callers request page=2 concurrently we race.
Maria: exactly. Also auth retry will re-run the original call after refresh — so double executor.
Sam: quick workaround — add a small in-memory map of inflight promises keyed by (path, query). Example: 
```js
const inflight = new Map();
function fetchPage(key, fn) {
  if (inflight.has(key)) return inflight.get(key);
  const p = fn().finally(() => inflight.delete(key));
  inflight.set(key, p);
  return p;
}
```
Maria: tested that and it prevents dupes, but wonder if we should bake into SDK.
Jordan: SDK parity note — python and go SDKs don't prefetch by default. JS does for UX. We need documented guidance for token refresh interplay.
Liam: another mitigation: idempotency key header per request so server drops duplicates. But not always possible for paginated reads.
Sam: agree. For writes idempotency works. For paging, inflight promise dedupe is best. We should also add jittered backoff on prefetch to avoid thundering on token refresh.
Maria: filed a tiny sample-app PR that toggles prefetch=false on slow auth to demonstrate. PR link: (removed)
Jordan: can we add an opt-in behavior in JS SDK: `dedupeInFlight: true` and keep default true for sample-app?
Sam: fine with that. We'll need tests: concurrent callers, token-refresh stub, and ensure no memory leaks.
Maria: test matrix I ran: 50 concurrent scrolls, token refresh latency 800ms -> without dedupe 30% 429s, with dedupe 0.
devex-bot: FYI @team: created issue DEVEX-5234 "js-sdk: inflight dedupe + doc for prefetch+auth"
Maria: tagging @Sam @Jordan for review, and @Liam for infra thoughts on server-side idempotency.
Liam: will chat with infra about tolerant 429 handling and small server-side cheap dedupe when possible.
ops-bot: deploy 2024-05-07T16:12:03Z: sample-app fix rolled out to staging :rocket:
Maria: great, thanks everyone. I'll add a short blurb to onboarding guide about turning prefetch off if you expect flaky auth. :+1:
Jordan: can someone file a follow-up to audit other sample apps for same pattern?
Maria: filing now.
Sam: thanks — will pick SDK PR after lunch. :coffee:
